initiatives.name: Alternatives for Community and Environment (ACE)
initiatives.description: Roxbury-based environmental justice group, founded in 1994, that runs youth organizing (REEP) and resident campaigns and gives legal and technical help to communities across Massachusetts.

initiatives.name: Queer & Trans Mutual Aid Massachusetts (QTMAMA)
initiatives.description: Collective of LGBTQIA+ Massachusetts residents that organizes mutual aid, including small 'community pods' whose members help each other and bring larger needs to the wider group.

initiatives.name: Food For Free
initiatives.description: Cambridge-based food rescue nonprofit, founded in 1981, that collects surplus fresh food and distributes it through pantries, schools, and meal programs across Greater Boston.

initiatives.name: Lawrence Community Fridge
initiatives.description: Free community fridge and free-goods table at 163 East Haverhill St., South Lawrence, MA, run on a take-what-you-need, give-what-you-can basis. Site is in English and Spanish.

initiatives.name: Stone Soup Cafe
initiatives.description: Pay-what-you-can community cafe at 399 Main St, Greenfield, MA. Runs soup nights, Saturday meals, a soup CSA, a community store and solidarity workshops.

initiatives.name: Massachussetts Transgender Political Coalition
initiatives.description: MTPC works to ensure the wellbeing, safety, and lived equity of all trans, nonbinary, and gender expansive community members in Massachusetts.
